name: xArm joint repair
summary: A wizard for UFACTORY's joint-encoder repair (S17, S18) and zero reset: one instruction at a time, a ✓ or ✗ after each, then the next step.
help: For an xArm whose UFACTORY Studio has no Joint debug page (before 2.4.0), or cannot be updated. Connects to the arm at Arm IP address, reads which joint reports an error, and leads you one step at a time in a Step-by-step guide view (live: guide): read the instruction, do it, press the button it shows; the block checks what it can on the arm, shows ✓ or ✗ and the next step. Steps: read the arm; mark the joint; send the clear command (H101 D0813 V256 I<joint> for S18, V2 for S17; when S18 clears and S17 shows, the guide goes on with V2); E-stop; clear the arm's error; is the zero right? If not: unlock the joint (H101 D0104 V1 I<joint>), turn it by hand to its zero, E-stop, make this position 0° (D13 I<joint>, sent as the SDK's set_servo_zero), E-stop, motors on, check. The arm answers 1 (or 2) to commands while it still has an error (or warning) not cleared: the command is taken all the same. A command is sent only from the step that shows it (the orange button); a press at the wrong step does nothing and says which one the step needs; an error at a step shows as ✗ and the run goes on. Back, Start over, Finish. Every command and the arm's answer go to joint_repair.csv. Arm: the arm's type (firmware 1.4 does not tell the SDK). The joints that hold the arm up (2 and 3; 2 and 4 on an xArm 7) make the arm fall when unlocked: their step says so. Robot model (optional): connect the xArm model block, so it is made before this block starts and the 3D view shows the arm during the repair. Robot = rehearsal sends nothing: a pretend arm with an S18 error answers. Live: guide, health (connected, error, servo, angles), joints. Use only as UFACTORY's support tells you: these are their debug commands.
